source_quality.notes: The text layer is not valid UTF-8 and every displayed formula is corrupted in it, so equations (1) to (28) and Figures 2, 3 and 9 were read from review proxies. Printed footer page N sits two render pages behind the printed number. The prose is non-native and its slips are preserved rather than corrected.

task_reconstruction.summary: Score the maturity of a data-and-analytics system for a cargo firm, place it on a five-level scale, and show how to reach the top level at the least difficulty.

section_map.summary: The summary argues maturity is worth measuring and lists the assessment, the optimization and the scale extension.
Section 1 grants that data supports decisions, then says preserving it is already hard, let alone using it.
Section 2 states four assumptions, each paired with a justification.
Section 3 hands every symbol to one table.
Section 4 defines twelve indicators and the two scoring methods.
Section 5 turns the upgrade into a vector that lands on a target surface.
Section 6 gives a procedure per component as guidance for judging effectiveness.
Section 7 rescales the component weights by firm size and tries the model on seaports.
Section 8 lists reliability checks, strengths, and two conceded limits.
Section 9 is a letter telling port users not to lose confidence if the score is low.

contributions.summary: Twelve indicators, nine written as closed formulas, each forced toward one as the best value.
A stated mix that gives the entropy weights four fifths and the hierarchy weights one fifth.
An optimization drawn as a step from the current score vector onto a target surface.
A rescaling that lets firm size change the three component weights.

dependency_graph.via: the indicators are the columns being weighted
the component scores are averaged and then mixed with the fuzzy score
the current score vector is what the step pushes to the surface

assumptions.summary: The data is precise because it comes from official sources.
The experts are equally professional, since the weighting gives no way to tell them apart.
The client's data is accessible because the client can collect it.
Minor indicators are dropped by the Pareto principle.

data_and_preprocessing.summary: Indicators are rescaled to the unit interval by their column minimum and maximum before the entropy is computed.
Seaport berth counts from the Ministry of Transport are fitted with two quadratics.

models.summary: Nine indicator formulas covering people, technology and process.
A fuzzy evaluation combined with entropy weights and hierarchy weights.
A vector optimization that minimizes difficulty subject to reaching an average of 0.8.
A scale-demand rescaling that turns fitted demand curves into component weights.

verification.summary: The two demand curves cross at one reported point, read as support for equal weights at that particular scale.
The two quadratic fits return coefficients of determination 0.9758 and 0.9731.

results_trace.summary: Three entropy weight vectors and three hierarchy weight vectors are reported as numbers.
The final score is four fifths of the weighted score plus one fifth of the fuzzy score.
The fitted curves cross at a berth count of 1000.8 with value 0.9627.

writing_logic.summary: The summary escalates two gains into a reason to model, then lists the methods in order.
Every assumption is paired with a justification on its own line.
The weaknesses are stated as things the model cannot do, not as afterthoughts.

language_observations.summary: The more, the more, and the more. Thus, worthy of attention.
Aware of this, we establish, not only for the client but also for other firms.
We attach greater significance to the entropy method, since it is more objective.
Thus, the choice depends on urgency.
Do not lack confidence. If this were the case. Our team have every reason to believe.

visualization_observations.summary: Figure 2 draws the integrated weights as three donut charts, one per component.
Figure 3 draws the current vector, the improvement step and the difficulty direction inside a cube cut by the target plane.
Figure 9 plots the two fitted demand curves against berth count and marks where they cross.

judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A judge can see the whole optimization in one figure: where the system is, where it must get to, and which direction costs the most.
The crossing of the two fitted curves is the only place the equal-weight assumption is checked against data.

weaknesses.summary: Working efficiency takes the worse of the two skills, so the better one never counts.
Cost accuracy has no absolute value, so the score can exceed one or turn negative.
The Defined and Managed bands both open at 0.4, so they overlap.
The reported weight vectors do not all sum to one.
The paper concedes that improvement inside a level cannot be done with this model.

independent_extensions.summary: Rescaling component weights by a fitted function of organization size would transfer to any maturity model whose parts matter differently for small and large organizations.

unresolved_questions: Why does equation (2) score efficiency by the worse skill alone?
Why does equation (5) omit the absolute value the schedule formula uses?
Why do the Defined and Managed bands both open at 0.4?
Why do the reported weight vectors not sum to one?
What objects was the entropy computed over?
What values does the difficulty vector take?
Why does equation (13) print Z_m while the prose uses Z_F?
Why does equation (23) use v_i while the prose says k_i?
